metadata.title: The CEO's Midnight Contract
metadata.subtitle: My cold billionaire boss accidentally sent a love confession to our work chat—then unsent it.

nodes.text: 11:58 PM · Working overtime on the 38th floor. Your famously cold billionaire CEO just texted the Executive Project Group.
I can't stop thinking about {{player_name}} tonight. Cancel my engagement dinner—I'm choosing her.
...Wait. Did Julian Vance just unsend THAT in the company group chat?!
Haha, looks like Julian's phone got hacked! Anyway, {{player_name}}, where are my Q4 slides?
One second later, a Private DM from Julian Vance lights up your screen.

nodes.transcript: [Low, breathless voice] {{player_name}}... come up to the 45th-floor penthouse office right now. Don't tell a soul you saw that.

nodes.prompt: Your heart races as the private elevator chimes. What do you do?

options.label: Take the VIP lift to the 45th floor
options.player_reply_text: On my way up, Mr. Vance.

options.label: Check who else read his unsent text

nodes.text: The VIP lift opens onto the 45th floor. City lights shimmer behind Julian's desk—where a velvet folder labeled 'CONFIDENTIAL CONTRACT' waits.
SECRET UNLOCKED: You check the chat audit log—Elena DID screenshot Julian's confession and already forwarded it to the Chairman's daughter!
Elena screenshotted it to sabotage both of us... I have to warn Julian right now!
Sign this six-month contract, {{player_name}}. Be my fiancée at tomorrow's gala—and I'll save your father's studio from bankruptcy tonight.

nodes.headline: Six Months As His Secret Fiancée...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 2: Before your pen touches the page, a leaked elevator photo explodes in the board group chat.

nodes.text: 12:25 AM · Inside the 45th-floor penthouse office. Rain streaks the glass wall as Julian slides a gold fountain pen toward you.
Private DM · Boss, emergency! Elena just leaked a blurry elevator photo of you and {{player_name}} to the board chat!
By sunrise {{player_name}} will be fired for leaking merger bids—and the VP seat is mine.
She didn't just leak a photo... Elena is framing me for stealing our confidential merger bid!

nodes.transcript: [Calm, fiercely protective] Look at me, {{player_name}}. Nobody touches what's mine. Sign page two—and walk into the boardroom on my arm at 9 AM.

nodes.prompt: Julian's hand brushes yours over the contract. What do you do?

options.label: Sign the contract & fight back together
options.player_reply_text: Deal. Let's show Elena who she just messed with.

options.label: Read hidden Clause 9 before signing
options.player_reply_text: Wait—what is this tiny clause at the bottom of page two?

nodes.text: You sign your name in bold ink. For the first time in two years, Julian Vance breaks into a genuine, breathtaking smile.
Welcome to the game, {{player_name}}. Tomorrow, Elena learns who truly runs this tower.
SECRET UNLOCKED: Hidden Clause 9 reveals Julian quietly paid off your father's debt THREE YEARS AGO—he has been protecting you in secret since college!
Julian... Clause 9 says you bought my dad's studio debt three years ago?! That wasn't an accidental message tonight, was it?

nodes.transcript: Sir, {{player_name}}—the Chairman just stormed into the lobby! And he's riding the VIP elevator up with your ex-fiancée and security!

nodes.headline: Caught On The 45th Floor...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 3: The Chairman steps out of the elevator—and Elena drops a forged NDA breach on the table.

nodes.text: 10:15 PM · 45th Floor Penthouse. The elevator doors slide open, and the Chairman's gaze locks onto Julian's hand on yours.
See, Chairman? {{player_name}} isn't just violating company policy—she leaked our Q4 bid!

nodes.caption: Leaked NDA Audit: Alleged export logged under {{player_name}}'s badge at 9:40 PM.

nodes.text: At 9:40 PM I was stuck in the glass boardroom with Julian! That log is forged!
If you touch her career, Elena, I will liquidate my voting shares tomorrow morning.
Boss! I checked the server IP—that export came from Elena's assistant terminal, not {{player_name}}'s!

nodes.transcript: [low, commanding] Listen closely, {{player_name}}. Stand beside me and don't blink. I'm done hiding how I feel.

nodes.text: The Chairman gave you until tomorrow night's gala, Julian—marry the merger heir or lose the CEO seat!

nodes.prompt: The Chairman waits for your answer. How do you respond?

options.label: Demand a live IT audit right now
options.player_reply_text: Run the server audit in front of the Chairman—I have nothing to hide.

options.label: Call out Elena's secret meeting with Rival Corp
options.player_reply_text: Ask Elena why she was photographed at the Rival Corp lobby at 8:00 PM!

nodes.text: IT audit confirmed! {{player_name}}'s badge was spoofed—cleared 100%!
VIP TWIST: Elena's face drains of color as the Chairman orders an immediate security pull on the 8:00 PM lobby tape!
You're not leaving my side tonight, {{player_name}}. Tomorrow's gala is going to be war.
Enjoy your little victory—let's see who smiles when the board votes tomorrow.

nodes.headline: The Gala Trap...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 4: Lobby CCTV exposes Elena's real buyer—just as the midnight board vote begins.

nodes.text: 9:30 PM · Grand Ballroom Gala. Champagne glasses clink while phones buzz under silk tablecloths.
{{player_name}}, emergency! Elena just locked Julian in a closed-door board caucus!

nodes.caption: Hotel Lobby CCTV (8:05 PM): Elena handing a silver USB drive to Apex Holdings' VP.

nodes.text: A silver USB drive?! She's selling Vance Group's flagship patent to Apex!
Whatever they vote tonight, I only care that you're waiting for me outside the doors.
Too slow, {{player_name}}. The Chairman is signing Julian's removal order in five minutes.

nodes.transcript: [whispering fast] I have the live feed to the ballroom projector! Say the word and I'll put that lobby CCTV on the 20-foot screen!

nodes.text: Wait—don't make yourself a target, {{player_name}}. Let me take the hit.

nodes.prompt: Five minutes until Julian loses his company. What do you do?

options.label: Walk into the boardroom with the CCTV file
options.player_reply_text: Open those doors, Noah. I'm handing this directly to the Chairman.

options.label: Hijack the ballroom projector right now
options.player_reply_text: Hit the projector, Noah—let every investor in this ballroom see who the real traitor is!

nodes.text: The Chairman just froze the vote! He's staring straight at Elena!
VIP TWIST: The 20-foot screen lights up with Elena's USB handoff—300 investors gasp in unison!
That photo is doctored! Security, cut the screen!
Don't touch a single wire. And Elena... wait until you see the bank wire that arrived ten minutes ago.

nodes.headline: Penthouse Showdown...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 5: A $2M offshore kickback seals Elena's fate—and Julian reveals why he wrote Clause Nine.

nodes.text: 11:20 PM · Executive Boardroom. Only the Chairman, Julian, Elena, and you remain under the crystal chandelier.
Elena, you forgot one detail: Apex Holdings' escrow bank reports directly to my compliance desk.

nodes.caption: Offshore Kickback: $2,000,000 wired from Apex Holdings to Elena's Swiss account.

nodes.text: How did you—?! That account was under a holding company!
I stayed cold to everyone for five years—until the night you stayed late to fix my presentation.
Corporate security and legal counsel are waiting outside the glass doors, Mr. Vance.

nodes.transcript: [soft, earnest] The Chairman just withdrew the arranged merger. There's only one contract left on my desk—and you get to tear it up.

nodes.text: You really threw away a billion-dollar alliance for your own assistant?!

nodes.prompt: Elena is escorted out. Julian hands you the midnight contract. Your move?

options.label: Negotiate a permanent VP role first
options.player_reply_text: Keep the romance—but put my VP offer letter in writing first, Mr. CEO.

options.label: Tear up Clause Nine right in front of the board
options.player_reply_text: No more secret clauses—if you want me, ask me without a contract.

nodes.text: Done. VP of Strategy—effective immediately. Now can I take you to dinner?
VIP TWIST: Confetti of torn contract pages falls across the oak table as the Chairman smiles and applauds!
For the record, I’ve been shipping you two since the day you two signed that contract.
Meet me on the rooftop helipad at midnight, {{player_name}}. One last surprise.

nodes.headline: No More Clauses
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 6 (Season Finale): Midnight above the city skyline—Julian has one final question with no fine print.

nodes.text: 12:00 AM · 45th Floor Rooftop Terrace. City lights sparkle beneath a canopy of stars.
The stock jumped 14% after the board announced you as our new VP of Strategy.
And Elena's indictment just hit the financial news. Not a bad night's work.
Cleared the rooftop for you two—champagne is chilled. Don't mess this up, Boss!
I practiced this speech ten times and I'm still more nervous than my IPO.
You saw through every wall I built. No NDAs, no midnight clauses—just you and me.

nodes.transcript: [warm, breathless] "{{player_name}}, I fell for you long before that wrong-chat text. Stay with me—not for a contract, but for real."

nodes.text: Wait... is that a velvet ring box in your blazer pocket, Julian Vance?

nodes.prompt: Julian steps closer under the city lights. Choose your Season Finale!

options.label: Kiss him and say yes to forever
options.player_reply_text: No more fine print, Julian. The answer is yes.

options.label: Make the billionaire CEO kneel on the rooftop
options.player_reply_text: You want a deal, Mr. CEO? Ask me properly—on one knee.

nodes.text: Best merger of my entire life.
VIP FINALE: The ruthless billionaire drops smoothly to one knee beneath the skyline—and slips the diamond onto your finger!
Saw it from the elevator window—congratulations, future Mrs. Vance!
Midnight belongs to us now, {{player_name}}.

nodes.headline: Act 2: The Phantom Merger Clause...
nodes.teaser_text: The contract is torn—yet a secret takeover addendum just hit the board server with your forged seal. Episode 7 begins Act 2.

nodes.text: 12:18 AM · 45th Floor Rooftop. The champagne glasses barely touch before Noah’s emergency alert flashes across both screens.

nodes.caption: Sir, {{player_name}}—someone uploaded a hostile takeover addendum at 12:12 AM using {{player_name}}’s digital seal!

nodes.text: Impossible. That seal only unlocks from inside my executive suite with my biometric override.
Surprised, lovebirds? Security escorted me out at 11:40, so you can’t pin this midnight leak on me.
Wait... my spare admin keycard wasn’t in my blazer pocket after the gala...
Noah, I saw that unsent line. If Elena was already outside, there’s a second mole still inside Vance Tower.

nodes.prompt: The board server locks in ten minutes. What is your move?

options.label: Lock all 45th-floor lifts right now
options.player_reply_text: Freeze every executive elevator and pull the midnight badge log!

options.label: Trace the upload IP to its exact terminal
options.player_reply_text: Forget the lifts—trace the addendum’s IP packet before the cache wipes!

nodes.text: Done. Three badges swiped on Floor 45 after midnight: mine, Noah’s... and a guest pass issued to the Chairman’s wing.
VIP TWIST: The IP didn’t come from Floor 45—it was relayed through a hotel suite router directly across the street!
Wait—the document metadata shows a secondary approval timestamp from Aurelia Grand Hotel, Room 1809.
Room 1809 is booked under my company’s corporate retainer... and only four people know that account code.

nodes.headline: Room 1809 Keycard
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Someone booked a luxury suite across the street on Julian’s corporate tab—and left a keycard trail.

nodes.text: 1:05 AM · Aurelia Grand Hotel, 18th Floor. The corridor carpet muffles your footsteps as Julian taps the concierge tablet.

nodes.caption: Found this slipped beneath the concierge blotter. Room 1809—issued at 8:15 PM under Noah’s executive expense ID.

nodes.text: At 8:15 PM Noah was standing right next to us checking gala seating. Someone cloned his corporate ID!

nodes.transcript: [panicked] Sir, please don’t open 1809 alone—my phone just pinged a charge from that suite’s minibar two minutes ago!

nodes.text: Playing detective at 1 AM, {{player_name}}? Careful—some doors open onto secrets Julian begged his father to bury.
She’s stalling us. The lock light is green—do we swipe in right now or wait for hotel security?

nodes.prompt: Footsteps echo behind Door 1809. What do you do?

options.label: Swipe the keycard and push the door open
options.player_reply_text: Now, Julian—if we wait, whoever is inside wipes the laptop!

options.label: Block the service lift and trap the mole
options.player_reply_text: Don’t open it yet—cut off the staff elevator at the end of the hall!

nodes.text: Empty—the balcony door is swinging in the wind! But they left a shredded boarding pass to Zurich on the desk.
VIP TWIST: A courier bolts out of the service stairwell—dropping a burner phone flashing Elena’s missed calls!
Wait... why is Elena’s number calling from a prepaid line when she just texted us from her main phone?
Look at your phone, {{player_name}}. That exact prepaid line is ringing you right now.

nodes.headline: The Late-Night Call
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Elena calls from a burner line with a warning about the Chairman’s own shadow advisor.

nodes.text: 1:42 AM · Suite 1809. Rain lashes the 18th-floor window as an unknown caller ID vibrates across the glass table.
Put me on speaker, {{player_name}}. I was paid to sabotage the Gala—not to forge your seal on a hostile takeover!
Then who hired you, Elena? Talk before I hand your gala audio straight to Financial Crimes.
Your father’s own chief legal counsel! He’s using {{player_name}}’s father’s studio as leverage to force you off the board by Friday.
I deleted the 11:15 PM Corridor 45B clip because I saw the counsel’s cufflink...

nodes.prompt: Noah just exposed himself by accident. How do you react?

options.label: Demand Noah restore the 45B clip now
options.player_reply_text: Noah, don’t lie to us—pull that 11:15 PM corridor backup from the server!

options.label: Force Elena to name the offshore buyer
options.player_reply_text: Save the apology, Noah—Elena, give us the Cayman buyer’s name or the deal is dead!

nodes.text: I’m sorry! I saved an encrypted copy on my cloud drive before wiping the main console. Sending it now.
VIP TWIST: Elena whispers "Aurelia Capital"—the exact fund shorting Vance Holdings stock since Monday!
Noah, meet us in the security server room in twenty minutes. Bring every raw frame.
One last thing—when you watch that corridor video, zoom in on the man’s left wrist.

nodes.headline: Corridor 45B Footage
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: The restored CCTV silhouette reveals a midnight handoff right outside Julian’s private office.

nodes.text: 2:15 AM · Sub-Basement Security Vault. Blue monitor light washes over Julian’s jaw as Noah decrypts the deleted file.

nodes.caption: Frame 11:14 PM · Corridor 45B. Two figures trading a silver flash drive—and look at the platinum cufflink under the floodlight.

nodes.text: That cufflink was a 25-year service gift from my father. Only one senior counsel wears it.
Wait—the woman handing him the drive isn’t even Elena’s height. Who else had access to my studio contract?

nodes.transcript: [low, steady] Listen to me, {{player_name}}. Whatever hits at market open tomorrow, they’re trying to split us apart first. Don’t let them.

nodes.text: Sir—automated alert from Legal! An emergency board motion just filed to freeze your voting shares at 9:00 AM!

nodes.prompt: The freeze hits at 9 AM sharp. How do you counter?

options.label: Back up the CCTV clip to 3 secure servers
options.player_reply_text: Mirror this footage across three external vaults before Legal wipes the building!

options.label: Check who accessed the Chairman’s vault
options.player_reply_text: Pull the biometric log on the Chairman’s vault—they needed the master charter!

nodes.text: Mirrored and timestamp-certified. Even if they pull every plug in this tower, the clip survives.
VIP TWIST: The vault opened at 10:50 PM using a duplicate key signed out by Elena’s former deputy!
Get four hours of sleep, {{player_name}}. At 9 AM, the real war begins.
I’m not leaving your side tomorrow, Julian. Let them try to freeze us out.

nodes.headline: The Frozen Accounts
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Market open brings a brutal shock—Julian’s shares AND your father’s studio credit line are locked.

nodes.text: 9:20 AM · Sunlit Financial District. Ticker boards flash red outside the glass lobby as trading opens.
Julian! My dad’s bank just called—our studio’s credit line was frozen ten minutes ago because of the "disputed merger seal"!
Breathe. That’s exactly what they wanted—panic. I already wired a bridge retainer from my personal trust so your father’s payroll clears.
Check the business wire, Julian. The board just scheduled an emergency takeover vote for tomorrow at 9 AM sharp.

nodes.transcript: [calmly] They think freezing my corporate accounts leaves me powerless. They forgot I built my first fund before ever joining Vance Holdings.

nodes.text: Sir... {{player_name}}... I can’t keep quiet anymore. I need to meet you both in the atrium café right now. Alone.

nodes.prompt: Noah sounds ready to break. How do you approach him?

options.label: Promise protection if he tells the whole truth
options.player_reply_text: Come down now, Noah. Tell us everything and we’ll stand between you and them.

options.label: Ask Noah to bring his bank audit folder
options.player_reply_text: Don’t come empty-handed, Noah—bring the Q3 offshore wire ledger with you!

nodes.text: Thank you... I’m bringing the original hospital bills and the messages they used to blackmail me.
VIP TWIST: Inside Noah’s folder sits an unredacted wire routing slip linking the counsel directly to Aurelia Capital!
Wait—check who just walked into the atrium café behind Noah. Elena’s watching from the corner booth.
Good. Let her watch—because Noah is about to blow their entire syndicate wide open.

nodes.headline: Noah’s Confession
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Noah breaks down and reveals how he was blackmailed into cloning the hotel keycard.

nodes.text: 11:45 AM · Atrium Glass Café. Sunlight hits the espresso cups while Noah slides a crumpled envelope across the table.
My younger sister needed emergency heart surgery last month. The counsel paid the hospital—then demanded my keycard PIN in return.
Why didn’t you come to me, Noah? You’ve been at my side for five years.
Because he threatened to pull my sister off the donor list! I never gave him {{player_name}}’s seal—he forged that himself.
If that kid hands over the wire receipts, I’m finished too...
Elena just slipped up in the group thread. She’s terrified of what’s inside your envelope, Noah.

nodes.prompt: Noah offers to testify as your witness. What do you decide?

options.label: Accept his help and secure his sister’s care
options.player_reply_text: Julian will cover your sister’s clinic in full. Now help us end this tomorrow.

options.label: Use Noah as a double agent until 9 AM
options.player_reply_text: Stay silent in front of them tonight—feed the counsel fake panic while we pull the bank trail!

nodes.text: I won’t let you down again. I kept copies of every offshore wire the counsel routed since January.
VIP TWIST: Noah texts the counsel "Julian is packing his office"—tricking the mole into sending his final Cayman transfer early!
Noah, send the Cayman routing numbers to my forensic auditor right now.
Uploading now—wait until you see the $18 million figure at the bottom of page two.

nodes.headline: The Cayman Wire
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: An $18M offshore transfer proves who financed the hostile takeover from behind the curtain.

nodes.text: 2:30 PM · Private Audit Suite. Spreadsheets glow across three monitors as the forensic trail locks in.

nodes.caption: Confirmed wire receipt: $18,000,000 routed from Aurelia Capital to a shell firm co-signed by the Counsel AND Elena.

nodes.text: Wait—Elena swore she wasn’t part of the takeover! Her signature is right beside his on the shell company payout!
She tried to play both sides so she’d survive whoever won. That ends tomorrow morning.
Enjoying your afternoon, Julian? By the way, your father just boarded a flight from Geneva—and the Counsel is meeting him at the airport.
Damn it. If the Counsel poisons my father’s ear before I land the audit report, the Chairman will sign the proxy vote tonight.

nodes.prompt: Julian is racing to intercept his father. What do you do?

options.label: Send the wire proof straight to the Chairman
options.player_reply_text: Don’t wait for traffic—email the verified wire slip to your father’s private tablet now!

options.label: Alert Economic Crimes to flag the escrow
options.player_reply_text: Forward the wire packet to Financial Crimes—freeze their $18M escrow before sunset!

nodes.text: Sent—read receipt just popped up! My father’s tarmac car stopped on the runway.
VIP TWIST: Financial Crimes issues an immediate freeze code—Elena’s personal bank app flashes ACCOUNT LOCKED!
Heads up—the Counsel just filed a last-minute court injunction trying to ground Julian’s private jet at the hangar!
Wait... Julian’s phone just went straight to voicemail. Where is he?!

nodes.headline: Grounded On The Tarmac
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Mid-Season Twist—a storm hits the airport tarmac as Julian calls from behind police tape.

nodes.text: 9:10 PM · Storm clouds drown the city skyline. Rain hammers your studio window as Julian’s encrypted line finally breaks through.
I’m okay, {{player_name}}! Their injunction stalled my car for two hours, but I reached my father before the Counsel did.
Thank God... What did the Chairman say when he saw the $18M wire?

nodes.transcript: [fiercely] He told me not to warn them. He wants us to walk into the 9 AM boardroom tomorrow and let them hang themselves live.

nodes.text: Tomorrow at 9 AM Julian loses Vance Holdings—and {{player_name}} loses everything.

nodes.prompt: Elena thinks she has already won. How do you answer her?

options.label: Stay silent and let her walk into the trap
options.player_reply_text: See you at 9 AM sharp, Elena. Don’t be late for your own finale.

options.label: Drop a single hint about the platinum cufflink
options.player_reply_text: Tell the Counsel to polish his platinum cufflinks—the 45B camera loves them.

nodes.text: Bold words for someone whose studio is one signature from foreclosure.
VIP TWIST: Elena’s typing indicator flashes for forty seconds straight—then vanishes in sheer panic!
The forensic binder is printed, sealed, and waiting on the 45th floor. Ready for the Midnight War Room?
I’m pulling into the garage now, {{player_name}}. Tonight we write the final chapter.

nodes.headline: Act 3: Midnight War Room
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Act 3 begins—one night left to assemble the airtight ambush before the 9 AM boardroom showdown.

nodes.text: 11:30 PM · 45th Floor Executive Suite. Rain beads down the panoramic glass while evidence folders cover the mahogany desk.
Three pieces lock the case: the 45B footage, Noah’s testimony, and the $18M Cayman wire. Only one weak link remains.
Elena’s shell company claim. If she lies and says her signature was forged too, the board vote could still stall.
She’s proud and impatient. If she thinks you’re wavering before the vote, she’ll try to buy you off in person tomorrow morning.
No way. I’m not letting you walk into a private meeting with Elena without backup.
Not private—right in the sunlit executive lobby, with my phone recording every single word.

nodes.prompt: Should we leak the wire to the press tonight or save it?

options.label: Hold everything for the live 9 AM ambush
options.player_reply_text: Zero leaks tonight—I want to see their faces when every board tablet lights up at once.

options.label: Tip off one trusted financial reporter
options.player_reply_text: Embargo the file with the Business Daily—publish the second the board gavel drops!

nodes.text: Remind me never to cross you, {{player_name}}. Every director’s tablet is queued for my signal.
VIP TWIST: The editor locks the front-page headline for 9:30 AM—"HOSTILE TAKEOVER FRAUD EXPOSED AT VANCE TOWER!"
Whatever happens in nine hours, {{player_name}}—thank you for fighting beside me without flinching.
We finish this together, Julian. See you at sunrise.

nodes.headline: Elena’s Last Bluff
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: An hour before the vote, Elena offers $5 million for you to walk away—straight into your live mic.

nodes.text: 7:45 AM · Vance Tower Executive Lobby. Crisp morning light pours through marble pillars as Elena steps out of the espresso bar.
Smart girls take the exit before the ship sinks, {{player_name}}. Walk out before 9 AM and my backers clear your father’s studio debt plus $5M.
Your backers? You mean Aurelia Capital and the Counsel who split $18M with you?

nodes.transcript: [smug whisper] Lower your voice! Yes, I signed the shell payout—and once Julian is voted out in an hour, nobody can touch a cent of it.

nodes.text: Thanks for putting that in a voice note, Elena. Saved me the trouble of hiding a microphone.
Wait—delete that! Give me your phone right now!

nodes.prompt: Elena lunges toward your phone in the lobby. Your move?

options.label: Step back and forward the audio to Julian
options.player_reply_text: Too late—it’s already synced to Julian’s boardroom deck!

options.label: Play her voice note out loud on lobby speaker
options.player_reply_text: Want to hear how guilty you sound in front of the arriving directors?

nodes.text: Audio received, crystal clear. Step into the VIP elevator, {{player_name}}—security is right behind you.
VIP TWIST: Three senior board members freeze mid-step as Elena’s whispered confession echoes across the marble lobby!
Doors to the Glass Boardroom open in one hour. The Chairman just arrived and took the head seat.
Walk in with your head high, {{player_name}}. It’s time to take back everything they tried to steal.

nodes.headline: The 9 AM Ambush
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: The proxy vote begins in the Glass Boardroom—and your forensic dossier shatters the Counsel’s coup.

nodes.text: 9:05 AM · 45th Floor Glass Boardroom. Twelve directors sit in tense silence as the Counsel calls for the removal vote.
Seven votes against Julian already. Pack up your desk, Vance.
Before the tally closes, I’d like every director to tap the encrypted packet {{player_name}} just pushed to your tablets.
LIVE BROADCAST: The 45B CCTV footage, the $18M Cayman wire, and Elena’s lobby voice note play simultaneously across the room!
Look at the Counsel’s face—he’s trying to pull his cufflinks off under the table!
Every forged seal, every offshore transfer—verified by independent audit. Still want to count those seven proxy votes?

nodes.prompt: The Chairman stands up and looks at you. What do you demand?

options.label: Void the takeover and call Economic Crimes
options.player_reply_text: Void the fraudulent motion and hand the Counsel’s file straight to Financial Crimes!

options.label: Unfreeze your dad’s studio on the record
options.player_reply_text: Unfreeze my father’s studio credit line on the record before anyone leaves this table!

nodes.text: Motion voided unanimously—12 to 0! And my father just signaled lobby security to seal the building.
VIP TWIST: The Chairman signs the bank release live—and awards your father’s studio a five-year flagship design contract!
This isn’t over—you can’t hold me here!
Elena just bolted for the service stairs—and Financial Crimes officers just stepped out of the lobby elevators!

nodes.headline: The Wire Reversal
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Investigators seal the basement garage as the $18M hostile takeover collapses in real time.

nodes.text: 10:15 AM · Basement Garage B2. Red-and-blue lights reflect off concrete pillars as the exit barriers drop shut.
Update from B2: Officers intercepted Elena and the Counsel right beside his sedan. Both phones seized as evidence.
If I hadn’t underestimated {{player_name}}, I’d be VP of the whole group...
The escrow bank just confirmed full reversal of the $18M wire. Vance Holdings stock is already up 14% since the halt lifted.
And my dad just texted—his studio’s credit line is green again. He’s practically crying.

nodes.transcript: [relieved] Thank you both—truly. The hospital just confirmed my sister’s surgery is locked in for Friday morning, fully covered.

nodes.prompt: The Chairman invites you to join the executive restructuring committee. Answer?

options.label: Accept as Creative Director for the group
options.player_reply_text: I’ll join—on my own terms, leading design for both the group and my father’s studio.

options.label: Promote Noah to Chief of Staff too
options.player_reply_text: Deal—only if Noah gets promoted to Chief of Staff for saving the company!

nodes.text: My father smiled for the first time all year. He says Vance Holdings finally found someone who won’t blink.
VIP TWIST: Noah nearly drops his tablet in shock as the Chairman signs his promotion charter on the spot!
Take the afternoon off, {{player_name}}. At 4:30 PM, answer my call—I have one piece of unfinished business.
No more midnight clauses, Julian?

nodes.headline: A Real Proposal
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: The storm has passed—and Julian calls from the sunlit rooftop garden with no contract in sight.

nodes.text: 4:40 PM · Late-afternoon gold spills across the skyline. Your phone chimes with a warm video-ring from Julian.
Step onto the 45th-floor terrace, {{player_name}}. Noah cleared the whole floor—just sunlight, breeze, and us.
P.S. He practiced his speech three times in the elevator mirror. Please say yes so I don’t have to listen to a fourth.
Haha, stepping out of the lift now! And Julian—you better not have a single fountain pen in your pocket.
No pens. No lawyers. Just one small velvet box I bought the morning after you stood up to my father.

nodes.prompt: Julian meets you by the sunlit glass railing. What do you say?

options.label: Tease him about the wrong-chat confession
options.player_reply_text: Admit it—that "wrong chat" confession at midnight wasn’t an accident at all, was it?

options.label: Take his hand and write your own Clause One
options.player_reply_text: I have one new clause: equal partners in the boardroom, and zero secrets at home.

nodes.text: Caught me. It was the only way I knew to stop you from walking out of my life.
VIP MOMENT: Julian laughs softly, drops to one knee under the golden sky, and opens the velvet box!
Will you marry me for real, {{player_name}}—no contracts, no deadlines, just every tomorrow we choose?
Yes, Julian. A thousand times yes.

nodes.headline: Grand Finale: Beyond Midnight
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 20 (Grand Finale): Sunset over the city as two hearts—and a rebuilt legacy—step into a brand-new dawn.

nodes.text: 5:30 PM · Golden Hour on the 45th Floor Terrace. City towers shimmer amber as the heirloom diamond catches the sunset.
Look down at the harbor, {{player_name}}. Every light turning on down there—and none of them shine brighter than you.
Chief of Staff reporting in: the press release is live, the studio flagship is funded, and champagne is chilling in the lounge!

nodes.transcript: [laughing warmly] Save this voice note forever, {{player_name}}—so you never forget the day the cold CEO finally met his match.

nodes.text: From a midnight wrong-chat message to standing here with you... I wouldn’t trade a single second of it.
One last decision for tonight, fiancée. How do we celebrate our first real evening?

nodes.prompt: The golden skyline stretches before you. Choose your finale!

options.label: Dinner at your father’s newly saved studio
options.player_reply_text: Let’s bring the champagne to my dad’s studio—family first, always.

options.label: Fly to the coast at sunset—just the two of us
options.player_reply_text: Clear the helipad—let’s chase the sunset over the coast before dinner!

nodes.text: Perfect. I’ll call the driver—and bring Noah along so we toast the whole team.
VIP GRAND FINALE: The helicopter lifts into the amber clouds as Julian holds your hand—no clauses, no rivals, only forever.
Thank you for trusting me past midnight, {{player_name}}. Welcome home.
Every midnight from now on belongs to us.

nodes.headline: No More Contracts. Only Forever.
nodes.teaser_text: 20-Episode Mega-Series Complete · You uncovered the corporate mole, defeated the hostile takeover, and wrote your own happily ever after.
